links.outcome: LLM cardiac event extraction accuracy across development, internal, and external institution cohorts
links.effect: Top three models achieved mean accuracies of 79.4%, 81.0%, and 79.3% for development, internal validation, and external validation cohorts; Llama-3.3 reached 85.5% on external validation.
links.quote: The top three models achieved mean accuracies of 79.4%, 81.0%, and 79.3% for the development, internal validation, and external validation cohorts, respectively.

unlisted_practices: Locally deployed open-source LLM for EHR cardiac event extraction with structured term matching plus specialty filtering, temporally aware queries and few-shot prompting

screen.reason: The study develops and performs multi-institutional validation of an LLM-based framework (TRACER) for extracting cardiac events from EHR notes, comparing model performance against physician adjudication without testing a deployment practice.
